summary: Items: the motifs, themes and pieces of a project, their versions and compositions.

commands.name: item.create
commands.summary: Make a motif, theme or piece with its first version

params.name: type
params.help: The kind of item.

params.name: name
params.help: The item's name.

params.name: project_id
params.help: The project that holds it.

params.name: body
params.help: The version's body: a motif, theme or piece body (formats ursatz-motif-body, ursatz-theme-body, ursatz-piece-body).

params.name: note
params.help: What the first version says; "Created" for a motif or theme when absent.

commands.reply: The item; analysis_error when the Composer could not analyze a motif.
commands.example:
item.create type motif name hook project_id prj-1
  body uses []
    motif role melodic form full notes "C4:e D4:e G4:q"

commands.name: item.update
commands.summary: Rename an item or move it to another project

params.name: name
params.help: The new name.

params.name: project_id
params.help: The project it moves to.

commands.name: item.delete
commands.summary: Delete an item and its variants

params.name: force
params.help: Delete the item although other items use it.

commands.reply: An empty object; used_by lists the items that use it when the delete is refused.

commands.name: item.save
commands.summary: Save the next version of an item

params.name: body
params.help: The version's body: a motif, theme or piece body (formats ursatz-motif-body, ursatz-theme-body, ursatz-piece-body).

params.name: note
params.help: What changed; required for a motif or theme.

commands.reply: The item; analysis_error when the Composer could not analyze a motif.
commands.example:
item.save item:mot-1@v1 note "Shorter"
  body uses []
    motif role melodic form full notes "C4:e D4:e G4:q"

commands.name: item.reanalyze
commands.summary: Analyze a motif again and save the result as a version

commands.name: item.compose
commands.summary: Compose a theme or piece into a new version

params.name: seed
params.help: The seed of the composition; one is drawn when absent.

params.name: update_uses
params.help: Move every updated use to its source's current version first.

params.name: settings
params.help: Settings for this compose only (the request scope): a preferences document, for a theme.

params.name: overrides
params.help: Overrides for this compose only: each {rule, action, weight}, for a theme.

params.name: off
params.help: Scopes this compose skips: style, taste or project, for a theme.

params.name: taste
params.help: The taste profile for this compose, for a theme.

commands.reply: The job that composes the item.

commands.name: item.explore
commands.summary: Compose a theme with some settings moved away from the taste

params.name: distance
params.help: How many settings move, 1 to 8; the resolved explore.distance when absent.

params.name: seed
params.help: The seed of the composition and of the moves; one is drawn when absent.

params.name: settings
params.help: Settings for this compose only (the request scope): a preferences document.

params.name: overrides
params.help: Overrides for this compose only: each {rule, action, weight}.

params.name: off
params.help: Scopes this compose skips: style, taste or project.

params.name: taste
params.help: The taste profile for this compose.

commands.reply: The job that composes the theme.

commands.name: item.regenerate
commands.summary: Write one section of a composed piece again as the next version

params.name: version
params.help: The composed version to work from; a number that names no version is not found.

params.name: section_id
params.help: The section to write again.

params.name: lane
params.help: The lane to write again; every lane when absent.

params.name: seed
params.help: The seed of the composition; one is drawn when absent.

commands.reply: The job that writes the section.
commands.example: item.regenerate item:pce-1@v3 version 3 section_id a seed 2

commands.name: item.variations
commands.summary: Make variations of a section of a composed piece

params.name: version
params.help: The composed version to work from; a number that names no version is not found.

params.name: section_id
params.help: The section to vary.

params.name: lane
params.help: The lane to vary.

params.name: count
params.help: How many variations.

params.name: seed
params.help: The seed of the composition; one is drawn when absent.

commands.reply: The job that makes the set of variations.
commands.example: item.variations item:pce-1@v3 version 3 section_id a lane melody count 3

commands.name: item.choose
commands.summary: Make one variation of a set the next version

params.name: version
params.help: The composed version the set belongs to; a number that names no version is not found.

params.name: set
params.help: The set of variations; a number that names no set is not found.

params.name: index
params.help: Which variation of the set, from 1.

commands.reply: The job that makes the version.

commands.name: item.set-op-checks
commands.summary: Replace the marks of Try every operation

params.name: checks
params.help: The marks by operation name: each {verdict (works or wrong), comment, seed, notes_text, date}; at most 64.

commands.example:
item.set-op-checks item:mot-1@v1
  checks
    invert verdict works comment ok seed 1 notes_text "C4:e" date "2026-11-20"

commands.name: item.save-variant
commands.summary: Save one candidate of the variants run as a derived motif

params.name: variant
params.help: A candidate from the variants query: chain, seed, kind, derivation and motive.

params.name: name
params.help: The new motif's name; one is made from the operations when absent.

params.name: flag
params.help: The new motif's flag; unflagged when absent.

commands.example:
item.save-variant item:mot-1@v1 flag approved
  variant seed 1 kind variant derivation "inversion"

commands.name: item.flag
commands.summary: Flag a derived motif as approved, rejected or unflagged

params.name: flag
params.help: The flag.

params.name: kind
params.help: How the derived motif relates to its source.

commands.name: item.promote
commands.summary: Save a variant as a motif of its own

params.name: name
params.help: The motif's name.

params.name: project_id
params.help: The project it moves to.

params.name: note
params.help: The version note; "Saved as new motif" when absent.

commands.example: item.promote item:mot-2@v1 name "New hook" project_id prj-1

commands.name: item.link-form
commands.summary: Record a motif as a form of another motif

params.name: source
params.help: The motif it is a form of: {item, version}.

params.name: recognition
params.help: A recognition from the recognize query that found a chain (found true, derivation, chain).

commands.example:
item.link-form item:mot-3@v1
  source item mot-1 version 2
  recognition found true derivation "inversion"

commands.name: item.reroll
commands.summary: Run a derived motif's chain again with a new seed
commands.reply: The job that makes the new version.

commands.name: item.restore
commands.summary: Make the next version a copy of an older one

params.name: version
params.help: The older version to copy, from 1; the current version is refused and a number that names no version is not found.

params.name: note
params.help: The version note (default: restore v<version>).

commands.reply: The new version number and the version it restores: {version, restored_from}.

commands.name: item.update-use
commands.summary: Move an item's use of a source to the source's current version

params.name: source_id
params.help: The source item the use names.

commands.name: item.apply-harmony
commands.summary: Apply a composed harmony plan to a theme or a piece section

params.name: harmony
params.help: The harmony item (hrm-...) whose composed version is applied.

params.name: version
params.help: The harmony version, which must be composed.

params.name: section
params.help: The name of the piece section the chords go to; required for a piece, refused for a theme.

params.name: note
params.help: The version note.
